existing_project_account_scope.evidence_level: Historical pupil-narrated project-process account, distinct from apparatus-name lists.
existing_project_account_scope.safe_process_summary: The account describes teacher encouragement, a committee-approved project proposal, repeated design revisions, separation of parts, defects and the body striking a school wall. Its narrator calls the attempt successful; that assessment is not independently validated.
existing_project_account_scope.test_date_scope: Project experiment date, not the January 1963 Alwaye fair date.
existing_project_account_scope.date_anomaly: The printed weekday/date combination is inconsistent with the Gregorian calendar; retain it rather than infer a corrected completion date.
existing_project_account_scope.credit_scope: Existing case preserves S. Sreedhar / S. Sridhar spelling variation; no new person or award to every group member named in the account inferred.

evidence_limits: Regional events, not proof of statewide inauguration, uninterrupted annual conduct, present-day categories or qualifying routes.
Narrative attendance figures are institutional reporting, not audited unique headcounts.
Exhibit lists usually identify subjects/apparatus, without reconstructable mechanisms or measured performance.
Teacher-meeting recommendations and speeches are historical attributed views, not current policy, an official current rubric or measured educational impact.
The two registered source IDs refer to this same scanned work, not independent corroborating publications.
No contacts, addresses, student IDs, participant photographs or full personal-name prize/teacher rosters are copied.
